objective: Transform browser-agent-driver into a small, powerful, code-native browser-agent harness with full per-step observability, trace-first evals, replayable experiments, held-out promotion gates, and an autonomous improvement loop.

metricClaims.agentTelemetryIntegrity: If agent telemetry integrity reaches zero findings on captured runs, engineers can trust cost, latency, token, tool, and failure measurements without replaying the run.
metricClaims.validatedAgentEvalSurface: If the pinned agent-eval surface audit passes, BAD can wire scorecards, raw-provider capture, held-out gates, analysts, and RL dataset exports without duplicating substrate code.
metricClaims.perStepCostAndLatencyCoverage: If every model/tool/planner step emits cost, latency, token, and failure metadata, optimization can target real user-visible reliability and spend instead of anecdotal traces.
metricClaims.canonicalRunRecordCoverage: If agent-run telemetry converts into validated RunRecords with profile-cell identity, benchmark improvements can feed scorecards and promotion gates without hand-written evidence translation.
metricClaims.benchmarkRecordingCoverage: If every benchmark wrapper forwards agent-eval identity metadata and only aggregates validated child RunRecords, campaign evidence can scale from single runs to multi-rep and A/B gates without losing provenance.
metricClaims.promotionGateCoverage: If one gate combines backend integrity, telemetry integrity, scorecard regressions, and held-out decisions, BAD can promote harness changes with a single reproducible evidence contract instead of scattered prose judgments.
metricClaims.rawProviderCaptureIntegrity: If every captured Brain provider call writes schema-valid raw request/response events keyed to its LLM span, assertRunCaptured can fail closed when AI SDK transport evidence is missing or mismatched.
